item.title: Level 3/4 flood threat issued for Grand Canyon National Park after flash flooding leaves at least 2 dead
item.description: At least two bodies have been recovered, more than a dozen people are missing and numerous others needed to be airlifted to safety as sudden flash flooding slammed Grand Canyon National Park Saturday afternoon. Park officials said flooding began in Bright Angel Canyon around 2:30 p.m., and the National Park Service had to evacuate 62 individuals by air from the Phantom Ranch camping area and the lower North Kaibab Trail.
